failure_modes: Ordinary-life recognition: a hospice nurse feeling she 'knew' a patient she'd never met; two living people in an NDE support group who felt they 'knew each other but didn't know why' (docs HwmnyYSXE44, Bvc3Y5SqpOk).
A family apparition seen in waking life rather than in an NDE - the sister who 'felt like we knew her, but we didn't know from where' was seen in the house, not on the other side (doc xZ_ID_3zt78).

Inverted phenomenon: an OBE-er looking down at her own LIVING husband and failing to place him ('I knew I knew him, but I didn't know who he was') - the same wording, the opposite experience (doc D3Ql06RhYlI).
A psychedelic ceremony in which the recognised beings turned out to be the physically present trip sitters (doc Dpbf1fK5J04).

best_quote.text: I noticed two figures. I mean, figures just like me. I sensed that I knew them, but not in this life. In fact, not in any life.

failure_modes: Dominant junk (12 of 19 FPs): the phrase 'the being that held me' from a single widely re-uploaded life-review testimony - an EMBRACE during the life review, not a halt. It appears near-verbatim in docs E7OaKzbPWgI, eNETJUp8URI, ZZGPNU28pbo, xiuSeJvsHcQ, lDSDP1tGfJ0, dT_jJEu7kRw, i6KdwZN0f_4, Xna-HGgLytk, z1QtKaNnN8o, ACneU_WZYjg, Z7vnMIgoWe0.
Hospital hands: paramedics putting their hands up to stop a relative reaching the gurney; a charge nurse putting her hand over the narrator's mouth (docs n1kf29odZoU, gpPurcd_ERU).

Ordinary-life scenes and figures of speech: a bridesmaid throwing herself on a car hood with arms out; 'it felt like a hand just held me back from being hit' as an illustration of everyday miracles (docs 8cnODbcgbBg, ZY1h7hqkDnE).
Hands used for something other than stopping - beings placing hands over the ears to relieve pain (doc 5JYUdLF7EAY).
audits.suggested_regex: (?:[Hh]ands?|[Aa]rms?|[Pp]alm)[^.!?]{0,80}(?:stopped me|stopping me|stop me|held me back|blocked me|couldn't go (?:any )?(?:further|farther)|not your time)|(?:stopped me|stopping me)[^.!?]{0,60}(?:hand|arm|palm)

best_quote.text: Suddenly, the one standing next to me raised his hand before what I can only equate as my face, stopping me from running forward.

failure_modes: 'Not a place OF X' constructions, which are evaluations rather than denials of location: 'it wasn't a place of punishment', 'it was not a place of sadness', 'it wasn't a place of passage', 'it was not a place where you would want to be' (docs CcRIwKX2QaM, hMSWWKrTeEA, o4JcqQPaoVo, B3yfVunO1t0).
Interviewer framing rather than experiencer testimony - two packets are the same host's question 'gives the impression that it was not a material place' (docs En-uQwoKdRA, ruQIUNs-xYs, O1f0heJGsUM).
The exact OPPOSITE claim: 'I've heard people say that heaven isn't a physical place, and I disagree... I think it is an actual place' (doc vko4tnKFRA8).

General theology about where souls go, not a perceived environment (doc Ht8fFjCAYNA), and plain ordinary-life idiom - Babaji's cave 'wasn't a place you could tour to', 'there wasn't a place to really help people' (docs IGj-rUp7sD0, 5U5VhcILuxk).
audits.suggested_regex: (?:wasn['’]?t|was not|isn['’]?t|is not) (?:really |exactly |truly )?a (?:physical |material |real )?place\b(?!\s+(?:of|for|to|where you would want|you could))[^.!?]{0,120}(?:environment|atmosphere|state of being|a state|realm|dimension|like here|physical location|floor|ceiling|buildings|landscape|geograph)

best_quote.text: And then I started to feel uncomfortable because it wasn't a place. And we're used to colors and then 3D and dimension. And I thought, "I wish it looked more like a place."

failure_modes: Overwhelmingly visitation DREAMS and after-death communications rather than NDEs - the 'Todd' visitation-dream account alone appears four times (docs Qw555prIkR0, SH2KAFC2yzg, d3FfvNmOi6g, hBVoA0vkbrs), plus a grandmother's presence felt in an apartment (PtTl_qJ_3zE) and a bedside apparition (-izaPscGjUs).
Mediumship and channelling sessions where the sitter didn't know the person had died (docs WalJw3rI9eo, eAwaG0TwVkU, AtHzYbZt-Ws).

Third-party retellings and researcher generalisations - the 'one woman was in a coma... she had no idea she was dead' anecdote recurs three times (docs OpUrgiYbA7Q, kEt_UIk4ty4, A1onYxA8wiY); also Jeffrey Long being summarised (AAPfM01EO6E), a deathbed-vision researcher (HgOId0hWfV4), a host's intro (pdZ18zb1eTA).
The inverted case: it is the DEAD person who doesn't know they're dead, not the experiencer who didn't know they'd died (docs ZroPOzfxF48, AtHzYbZt-Ws).
Post-coma disorientation ('when I came out of my coma, I didn't know my dad had died') and a past-life regression (docs INd_QHYJJCA, SBfzuW4J7tc).

Note: the phenomenon itself is clearly real in the corpus - it just cannot be found by matching 'didn't know X had died', which is dominated by dream visitations. Any rebuild should require a seeing/meeting verb inside the experience adjacent to the unknown death.

best_quote.text: Then I saw a neighbor that I didn't know was dead. I used to babysit for him.

failure_modes: 'Picket fence' as the standard American metaphor for conventional life - 'the picket fence, the marriage, the two kids', 'the house and the picket fence' (docs RvTt0Qyt-4Q, xtCpWPldQIE). This is the one recurring junk type; three of seven FPs.

Literal ordinary-world walls and fences: a hospital operating-room glass wall, a wooden fence in an apartment complex, and a rapid on the Rogue River nicknamed 'the picket fence' (docs lMEQ4Oe18FU, qt8LlDTFIk8, uHjUZNJ76dc).
A transparent wall used as a viewing window inside a craft, not a limit (doc Md2PdURAXGI).
An interview passage in which the experiencer explicitly DENIES having any sense of a limit or line (doc -wXVPKwR-OM).

best_quote.text: I understood without being told that if I crossed that line or passed through it, there would be no coming back.

failure_modes: Dominant junk: 'web of light' as a post-NDE metaphor for the community of awakened people - 'we are part of this web of light living on the earth', 'the worldwide web of light grows stronger', 'I do feel that we are a web' (docs Q_zxxxlz-BY, erdr_f7Q3Lo, -rbvd7s4o1A). Five of nine FPs are this.
New Age cosmology being taught rather than perceived: 'the good matrix, the universal consciousness, the web of energy', 'the grid of light that exists on the planet' (docs WMpe7PNqgZ0, 3YMv3-FTVkI).
Ayahuasca-ceremony teaching about 'the matrix we're in', which appears twice from the same speaker (docs wh5DaS6zyww, zwqIXOFCQTc).
Post-NDE psychic impressions of trees as 'a network of energy' (doc kiHW1mmCoB0).
audits.suggested_regex: (?:\bI (?:saw|was|entered|found myself)|looked like|appeared to be|described? (?:it )?as|embedded in|enveloped by|surrounded by|propelled (?:in)?to|moving into)[^.!?]{0,100}(?:spider ?-? ?web|matrix|lattice|network|mesh) of (?:light|lights|energy)

best_quote.text: I started moving into what I would describe as a spiderweb of light, just a beautiful matrix of light that was just streaming everywhere, and I was embedded in it.

failure_modes: 'Things I could have done differently' as ordinary retrospective regret, in this life and after it - business failures, parenting after a child's death, grief counselling, a pastor's 'it's not a path I would have chosen' (docs sL_KGIDJMcI, qmFtC1IHe0E, hdv3lC5mWTU, O_gDiLAN9F0, A2NGV591_Tw, qhYHcNf0sBY, WOcckxpAZeg).

Second-biggest source: one widely re-uploaded life-review account whose 'the things that I could have done and should have done and would have done differently' is regret INSIDE the review, not a display of alternatives (docs 7kDx-wkVzCM, -PNYA4cso1g, FJBZ5rEsJQM).
Generalisations about how life reviews work for everyone, spoken by hosts or teachers (docs 2xskMb26t2M, acbEt8BtJKI, mPc5R8WkwDc).
An OBE overhearing parents argue about 'what they could have done differently' in the waiting room (doc MZpBV3BZ1lc).
audits.suggested_regex: (?:show(?:ed|n)|saw|seeing)[^.!?]{0,70}(?:(?:all )?(?:the |these |those )?paths?(?: that)? I could have (?:taken|made)|what I could have been|what my life would have been|the future without me|the life[^.!?]{0,20}would have had|my potential)

best_quote.text: I saw all these paths that I could have taken when I was dead, and in this, it was like looking at the bottom of a large cable, a fiber optic cable made up of many fiber optic cables.

failure_modes: Dominant junk: miscarriage, stillbirth and abortion as BIOGRAPHY - the medical crisis that caused the NDE, or the speaker's obstetric history, with no encounter at all (docs KF1qu6P9pTo, XqtLcCDHSO8, PY5I2sCRQWE, yVxCeJVXGi8, sqaV-SF6pRQ, iAP38LkUxTU, IZBcv4So38s). Seven of eighteen FPs.
Doctrine and speculation about abortion, soul contracts and pre-birth plans, including one anti-NDE-community rant (docs turt5McjUlw, g3yQGY61eFc).
Researchers and hosts summarising the pattern in other people's NDEs - one packet states the entire claim verbatim as a generalisation about 'many NDErs' (docs nWjAa28WEc4, pYjYg1E4I0g).

Interviewer speculation ('what if one of them was the child you aborted?') and prophetic-ministry stories outside any NDE (docs fqQ0xxTmu6o, 7ST8RQYB4EM), plus one prayer-induced heaven visit rather than an NDE (doc mZ5CKy2i5cs).
audits.suggested_regex: (?:I saw|I met|met|saw|greeted|carrying|holding|introduced (?:me )?to|there (?:was|were))[^.!?]{0,70}(?:child|baby|son|daughter|sister|brother|boy|girl)[^.!?]{0,70}(?:miscarr\w+|stillborn|aborted)|(?:miscarr\w+|stillborn|aborted)[^.!?]{0,70}(?:was there|came (?:to|toward) me|I met|I saw|walking (?:down )?to me|hi,? ?mommy)

best_quote.text: Out of the corner of my eye, in a place I should not have been able to see, I saw my sister who died as a baby. Now she was walking down to me and carrying my son.

failure_modes: None. Every one of the 23 passages is a first-person report of knowing, without being told, that a specific further step ends the return - across water, a tree, a gate, clouds, a door, a threshold, a line, a light.

The only impurities are cosmetic: two passages run into channel boilerplate after the sentence (docs AEgxTodIs3o, YOi92hxfJgA) and three are the same 'behind this gate' testimony re-uploaded (docs WzyaTY1Wt5U, Y0McKoG83Ds, oRF8Y6GeJ4Q). Neither affects the judgement.
Caveat for the map, not the regex: duplicate uploads mean 23 matches are roughly 19 distinct accounts.

best_quote.text: but there was an energetic threshold, I knew if I stepped over that, I wouldn't be going back.

failure_modes: Other walls in other settings: the white walls of the oval-table review room, seen twice from the same experiencer (docs lMEQ4Oe18FU, aSNVGewTc0M), a low stone wall around a well in a hellish crowd (doc mPWwxnYiq9A), and a white bedroom wall in an optical-illusion experiment at home (doc K9vI9ZTn9fA).
Walls inside the realm that are not the boundary wall: stone walls around houses in an ancient village, and a garden wall with doors leading to life-review scenes (docs 46a6x_wZq70, rfTxpUTdJkc).

MAJOR CAVEAT for the map: 15 of the 16 true positives are one recurring 'Glorious City' testimony re-uploaded across many channels (cMBRXeUtKfs, kfDl0i4Z2sQ, jvhSmwTQ4-E, TsOGyCidXLQ, Bn5Rt-Sx-lE, cbTWrNqyMhM, 9T8RidoORJU, OmmjdXTVWNA, OMr1ntfvwgg, CiTPmS94xfE, 92eTYGTqvOk, b0hqU1UoD0g, Ot_oAFw1Qfw, SKL0T_1vodw, H6KUCZKU8No). Only one independent account (iyl-82q6Ha0, the low wall by the River of Life). The precision is real; the convergence is not.

best_quote.text: I'm standing at the golden wall that surrounded the Glorious City. And this wall was like real thick, pure gold cinder blocks, and it was so tall. I kept trying to jump the wall

failure_modes: Simile for trauma, not perception: 'I've had times where I felt like maggots were crawling in my skin' after being raped - appears twice from the same speaker (docs FDyJb9IhFIc, OE2RiW1JmE4).
Ordinary-life religious rhetoric: preachers calling Catholics 'serpents', twice from the same speaker (docs rx1rfPpbI-k, tdRdrfiacns).
Fear-of-the-grave references and an atheist father's mantra 'you're buried, the worms eat you' - explicitly NOT what was experienced (docs WalJw3rI9eo, yu9ljcHcu3w).
Post-NDE aftereffects and dreams about spiders and bugs (docs GJShJRwEf6o, 7cJiP2m6sss), plus 'my reptilian brain' in a hypothermia survival story (doc RVuU5U_0beI).

Adjacent-but-different infernal imagery that does not include vermin in the body: snake-pit past life, demons around pits, spiders on walls, tarantulas laid on bedding (docs M-DWYU1YJMU, gAJShDqxM1E, A2NGV591_Tw, DiqCVc2C9ck).
audits.suggested_regex: (?<!like )(?:worms?|maggots?)\b[^.!?]{0,60}\b(?:crawling|crawled|devour(?:ed|ing)?|eating|ate|clung|biting)\b[^.!?]{0,60}(?:my (?:body|skin|flesh|arms|bones|skeleton)|their flesh|your flesh|the flesh|in and out of me|through me)

best_quote.text: to see them fall inside of a hole and the worms devour their flesh and then then the flesh comes back on over and over again is a sight you just don't forget

failure_modes: 'Crossing a line' as a life metaphor: bereavement ('this line has been crossed in your life... that person's gone') and a self-protective rule adopted after an assault (docs I4PHMgUuTns, 3rAYA_P1pXQ).
A literal geographic line in the ordinary world - reindeer still refusing to cross the old Berlin Wall boundary (doc FNUtgGdfYws).
Note the packet is small and duplicated: 14 matches are about 10 distinct accounts (docs kfmkyqG6oO4/Cpc4xLUfza0, vjt-VgrOn7E/9oNvs75DDEk, c7PK7WmSDhM/TTDNl010QuA are pairs).

best_quote.text: I saw ... a line on the floor by the door ... like a yellow line ... made of light. But it was a yellow line ... like one ... a divider ... I don't know ... a line that I couldn't cross

failure_modes: Ordinary-world trees and hills: a car wreck that 'hit a tree' at the top of a hill, and an OBE over a familiar pond where the road 'bent up around the top of the hill' with treetops behind (docs 8X6GcHqiKqk, 8cnODbcgbBg).

Vegetation described as scenery inside the experience but with no single tree and no boundary function - a cerrado-like trail, and walking under trees checking their shadows (docs Cr_Bh4A9lCM, jK_wNH2hxes).

MAJOR CAVEAT for the map: six of the eight true positives are one experiencer (David McGinley) re-interviewed across six channels (AEgxTodIs3o, UPZ5Lat277I, 9uQPuelkQT0, jYXjxZVDWxI, TYiLzS6Jq54, YOi92hxfJgA). Only two independent accounts remain: the tree beyond the rock wall (ZH0J83t7LZs) and the young tree on the hill his boyfriend would 'become' (Q_DrclCSBaU). The image should not be presented as convergent.

best_quote.text: And at the top of the hill was that tree. With every fiber of my being, I had to run to that tree

failure_modes: The bridge as a metaphor for dying, from an 80-year-old interviewee - 'I recognize the bridge... and I go to the other side' - appearing twice as duplicate uploads (docs OizX472ycCw, coSo-eQS1jI).

Ordinary-world bridges: fleeing a pursuer over a street bridge at 6am, a retreat walk over a bridge to a waterfall, and a cobblestone bridge in an 1800s past-life memory (docs OLGWAewZDp0, Hsr31XRRqSI, tlQGWtu9emM).
A prayer visualisation - 'I pictured a golden healing, like a bridge' - imagined deliberately, not perceived (doc HfEcEjYuT9k).

Generalisation about what most NDErs report ('they couldn't cross a bridge, they couldn't cross a creek') and a third-person retelling of someone else's footbridge NDE (docs BXtPCN_At9Q, P1MVSAwKZ8Y). The second one is painfully on-claim but it is 'she', not 'I'.
Also note: the two strongest matches are the same experiencer (hhADKDdhTTk, IZWbojibwyA), so the surviving evidence is two distinct accounts, not three.
audits.suggested_regex: (?:\bfoot ?bridge\b|\bbridge\b[^.!?]{0,40}\b(?:creek|brook|brooklet|stream|golden railing)\b)[^.!?]{0,140}\b(?:I (?:saw|stepped|started|felt|was pulled|wanted)|cross that bridge|urge to cross|put (?:one )?foot)\b

best_quote.text: In front of me I saw a bridge hanging over a brooklet, and I stepped onto it. It was a narrow bridge with golden railings.
